subject: See you soon – getting here ({booking_ref})
preheader: Check-in {arrival_date}, {checkin_window}. Address and what to bring.
heading: See you in a few days, {guest_first_name}
body_html:
We look forward to welcoming you! Here is everything you need for your arrival.

Check-in and check-out

  • Check-in: {arrival_date}, {checkin_window}
  • Check-out: {departure_date}, by {checkout_until}
  • Later arrival is possible by arrangement – let us know your estimated arrival time.

Address

{business_name}, {business_address}.

{cta_button}

What to bring

To register your stay we need an ID card or passport for every guest. The tourist tax is payable on site.

{booking_summary}

If you are running late or need help on the way, call us on {business_phone}.

Safe travels!
{business_name}
